answer: The knoll chain is verified at intake and mirror publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 15 epochs old, anchored at a reef checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 15 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Repeating the trick 5 times costs 35 separate deposits and 34 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
